description: This Python module implements a gated frame aggregator class for processing frames in a frame processing pipeline. It accumulates frames conditionally based on user-defined gate open/close functions, allowing for complex control over frame buffering and release.

classes.name: GatedAggregator
classes.description: A frame processor class that accumulates frames based on custom gate open/close conditions, managing internal buffer and gate state.

methods.name: __init__( self, gate_open_fn, gate_close_fn, start_open, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM, )
methods.description: Initializes the GatedAggregator with gate functions, starting gate state, and frame direction.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, updating gate state and buffering or releasing frames accordingly.
